experiment: AC Rescue Lab Phase 3 — reference-truth audit + hard-negative blind-spot closure

audit_scope.note_on_the_3rd: 39657761 and 23b80f80 were the 2 canonicals ADR-320 flagged as contamination candidates; a 3rd (32cad851) was found to carry the identical defect signature while re-deriving the CLEAN-reference-only rerun in step 6 below, and was pulled into the audit once discovered — not part of the original 20 valid-tier or original 2-candidate scope, added because the evidence demanded it.

reference_reliability.key_positive_finding: ZERO of the 20 manually-audited VALID-tier canonicals exhibit the Type-A merge-contamination pattern found in the low-confidence tier. This is coherent, not coincidental: the contamination root cause (missing series_or_platform extraction for GREE) is exactly the attribute whose ABSENCE keeps a canonical out of valid tier in the first place — valid-tier's own admission requirement structurally screens out this specific failure mode. Valid tier does NOT, however, protect against the two other defects found (brand-extraction corruption, single-merchant under-corroboration) — those appear even inside the audited 20.

reconstructed_contamination_cases.canonical_name: Gree Split AC 24000 BTU Inverter hot cold
MERCHANTS: store 9 (x2 observations, one per merged product line)
reconstructed_contamination_cases.PRODUCTS_OFFERS: no storefront (products/product_stores) offers attached — this canonical exists only at the normalized_product_observations layer, never reached the storefront projection.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHY_IT_LOOKED_TRUSTED: identity_confidence=95, data_quality_score=85 on the canonical row — both HIGH scores, because those scores are computed from attribute-completeness (brand/type/capacity/mode/technology all stated) and observation count (4 observations), not from cross-observation CONSISTENCY. The scoring has no check for 'do all observations describe the same physical product.'
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHAT_IS_ACTUALLY_WRONG: 4 raw observations split into 2 genuinely different GREE model families: 'AI-PLUS/AI-PRO' (model prefix GWH24AVEXF, 3 observations — 2 from store 4, 1 from store 9) and 'Cosmo' (model GWH24AWEXF-S6DTA3H, 1 observation from store 9). Both families compute the SAME tps_identity_key ('gree|split|NO_SERIES|24000|Inverter|hot_cold') because GREE's parser does not extract series_or_platform — 'AI-Pro' and 'Cosmo' are both invisible to the identity key, so the matching layer correctly-by-its-own-rules attached both to one canonical. The canonical's own model_number field ('GWH24AVEXF-S6DTA1H/I') doesn't exactly match ANY single observation's stated code either (closest: store 9's bare 'GWH24AVEXF', missing the '-S6DTA1H/I' suffix) — suggesting the model_number field itself was set through some normalization step that altered the raw value.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHEN_THE_BAD_EVIDENCE_ENTERED: canonical created 2026-07-22; the AI-Pro observations arrived 2026-09-06 (store 4) and 2026-09-08 (store 9); the contaminating Cosmo observation arrived 2026-09-08T12:14:33.952Z — the EXACT same millisecond timestamp as the store-9 AI-Pro observation, meaning both came from the same store-9 scrape batch and were matched into this canonical in the same run.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHETHER_V1_WOULD_INHERIT_THE_ERROR: YES, structurally — V1's candidate generation treats this canonical as ONE candidate with ONE fingerprint (brand/type/capacity/mode/technology all agree, matching the Amazon AI-Pro listing on those attributes) and has no mechanism to detect that the candidate's own evidence is internally split between two different model lines. V1 classified the resulting case RESCUE_REVIEW (not HIGH_CONFIDENCE) — but for an unrelated reason (missing series_or_platform), not because it detected the contamination.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.CUSTOMER_FACING_RISK: MEDIUM — this canonical has no current storefront offers, so no customer-facing page is affected TODAY. If it were ever storefront-projected (via the same project-storefront-identity.ts pipeline used in ADR-312), a customer comparing 'Gree Split AC 24000 BTU' would see a price/feature comparison silently mixing two different GREE product lines (AI-Pro vs Cosmo), which could misrepresent either line's actual price or specs.

reconstructed_contamination_cases.canonical_name: Gree Split AC 18000 BTU Inverter cool only
reconstructed_contamination_cases.PRODUCTS_OFFERS: no storefront offers attached — same as above, normalized-layer only.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHY_IT_LOOKED_TRUSTED: 11 total deduped observations across 3 merchants — the highest observation count of any low-confidence GREE canonical in this population, which would read as strong corroboration under a naive 'more observations = more trustworthy' heuristic.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHAT_IS_ACTUALLY_WRONG: same root cause as the 24000 BTU case: observations split across AI-Pro/AI-Plus codes (GWC18AVDXE-family, 8 of 11 observations) and at least one Cosmo-family code (GWC18AWDXE, store 9) — again invisible to the shared tps_identity_key because series_or_platform is never extracted for GREE. This is the SAME systemic defect as the 24000 BTU case, not an independent coincidence — both are instances of one root cause (GREE parser has no series_or_platform extraction) manifesting wherever a store happens to carry both an AI-Pro/AI-Plus and a Cosmo listing at the same nominal BTU.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHEN_THE_BAD_EVIDENCE_ENTERED: canonical created 2026-07-21 — the OLDEST of the 3 now-known-contaminated canonicals; first observation 2026-06-12, meaning this specific contamination has been live for roughly 3 months, well before ADR-320 first surfaced it.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHETHER_V1_WOULD_INHERIT_THE_ERROR: YES — this canonical was in fact the WINNING (top-ranked) candidate for the corresponding Amazon GREE 18000 BTU listing in V1's Run A output (RESCUE_REVIEW). Human review, not V1 itself, is the only thing currently standing between this contaminated candidate and a false merge.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.CUSTOMER_FACING_RISK: MEDIUM, same reasoning as above — no current storefront exposure, but a real risk if this candidate is ever storefront-projected or if the REVIEW tier is ever relaxed.

reconstructed_contamination_cases.canonical_name: Gree Split AC 18000 BTU cool only
reconstructed_contamination_cases.discovered_via: Phase 3 step 6 (clean-reference-only rerun) — after excluding 39657761 as a candidate for the Amazon GREE GWC18AGD-S3DTA1A listing, this canonical becomes the new top-ranked candidate; inspecting ITS OWN raw evidence (not previously done in Phase 2) revealed the identical defect.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.WHAT_IS_ACTUALLY_WRONG: its 2 observations are 'مكيف جري جداري بارد فقط 18000 وحدة اي بلس انفيرتر واي فاي' (AI-Plus, Arabic) and 'Gree Cosmo Split AC, 18,000 BTU, Cool Only, White - GWC18AWDXE-S6DTA3' (Cosmo, English, EXPLICIT 'Cosmo' branding stated) — a third real instance of the exact same AI-Plus/Cosmo merge pattern.
reconstructed_contamination_cases.significance: this is not a new independent defect — it is the SAME systemic root cause (GREE series_or_platform extraction gap) recurring a third time, discovered specifically because Phase 3's clean-reference exercise forced a look at the NEXT candidate down the ranking. This raises material doubt that only 2 canonicals are affected; the true extent across the full ~970 low-confidence-tier population (not just the 3 examined here) is UNKNOWN and was not exhaustively scanned this phase — flagged as an open question, not resolved.

already_linked_finding.description: Independent of contamination, this phase discovered a distinct and important reference-truth fact: of V1's 4 RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE Run-A cases, 2 (both LG, both re-runs of the historical ADR-077 confusion) correspond to Amazon storefront rows that ALREADY had canonical_product_id set BEFORE this lab ever ran — i.e. production's own existing pipeline had already correctly linked them, independent of and prior to the AC Rescue Lab.

LG - ArtCool Split Air Conditioner, 18,000 BTU, Cooling Only - AM182C0.UK1

already_linked_finding.population_scan: checked all 270 Amazon AC storefront rows: exactly 2/270 are already canonical-linked, and both happen to be exactly these two RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE cases — no other Run-A case (eligible or not) is pre-linked.
already_linked_finding.reframing_required: V1's TRUE novel-rescue yield within the exhaustively-verified RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier is 2/4 (TCL, Haier — genuinely previously-unlinked), not 4/4. The other 2 are re-derivations of a link that already exists in production, independent of this lab. This does NOT weaken V1 — it is in fact a strong, independent OUT-OF-BAND precision check: V1 agreed with production's own already-established ground truth in 2/2 such cases, with zero disagreement — but the ADR-319/320 framing of '4 rescued products' should be corrected to '2 genuinely rescued + 2 independently-confirmed-already-correct', a materially different and more precise claim.

clean_reference_rerun.method: re-evaluated the 2 REVIEW-tier cases whose candidate pool touched a now-confirmed-contaminated canonical, applying V1's frozen ranking/classification rules (V1_SPEC.md, unmodified) to the candidate pool with contaminated canonicals removed. No candidate pool for any RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE or AMBIGUOUS case touches a SUSPECT, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, or CONTAMINATED canonical — confirmed by direct query, so those 7 cases are provably unaffected and were not re-run.

per_case_detail.clean: RESCUE_REVIEW (leading candidate becomes e2a1b3ab, which is itself a CLEAN but WRONG-LINE candidate — explicitly 'Cosmo' per its own raw title, GWH24AWEXF, while the Amazon listing is explicitly AI-Pro/GWH24AVEXF). V1's mechanical classification is unchanged, but a human reviewer given accurate reference data would now clearly REJECT this candidate as a different product line, versus being merely 'uncertain' before.

all 3 raw candidates are now disqualified — 39657761 and 32cad851 both confirmed contaminated (Type A), and the remaining candidate (91814ff5) is itself an under-specified, likely-Cosmo-line listing with no distinguishing evidence — NO_CANDIDATE.
per_case_detail.direction: RESCUE_REVIEW -> NO_CANDIDATE (a DOWNGRADE, i.e. more conservative, not less)

clean_reference_rerun.REFERENCE_CONTAMINATION_IMPACT: Zero impact on the RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier — the only tier any future trust decision would draw on. All impact is confined to the RESCUE_REVIEW tier, which was already human-gated and never eligible for auto-approval. Where contamination mattered, cleaning the reference universe made V1's OUTPUT MORE conservative (one REVIEW case downgraded to NO_CANDIDATE), never less. This is a reassuring structural finding: reference contamination in this dataset did not inflate confidence anywhere — it only ever risked misleading a human reviewer within a tier that requires human judgment regardless.

hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.case: Fisher Split AC FSACME-XF18CIB, cold only 18000 BTU (Amazon) vs trusted candidate 43ccfb48 ('Fisher Split AC 18000 BTU')
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.WHY_V1_MISSED_IT: V1's hard-conflict gate only fires when BOTH sides carry a non-null structured value for the compared attribute. The trusted candidate's structured cooling_mode field is null (parsed as NO_MODE in its tps_identity_key), so the gate had nothing to compare against Amazon's stated 'cold only' and let the candidate through.
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.WHICH_ATTRIBUTE_GATE_FAILED: the cooling_mode hard-conflict gate specifically — its logic is correct (reject on proven disagreement), but its INPUT was incomplete.
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.WHETHER_THE_DATA_WAS_AVAILABLE: YES. The trusted candidate's own raw observation title (store 5) explicitly states 'Fisher Split AC,18,000 BTU Hot / Cold, FSACQD-XF18HIB/FSACQD-XC18HIB' — the cooling-mode information existed in raw text but was never extracted into the structured field that V1's gate reads.
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.WHETHER_THE_REFERENCE_ITSELF_WAS_WRONG: No — this is not a merge/contamination case like the GREE ones (only 1 observation exists for this canonical, so there is nothing to be internally inconsistent WITH). It is an under-extraction: a true attribute value existed in the source text and was never captured, leaving the field null rather than wrong.
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.WHETHER_THIS_IS_GENERALIZABLE: Likely yes, but narrowly. cooling_mode extraction succeeds correctly on the large majority of observations reviewed across this whole audit (Haier 'Cool Only', multiple Gree 'Hot & Cold', Samsung 'Hot/Cold' etc. all extracted correctly) — the specific phrasing here ('Hot / Cold' with spaces around the slash) is a plausible regex-edge-case hypothesis distinct from the more common unspaced 'Hot/Cold' or ampersand-joined 'Hot & Cold' forms seen elsewhere in this same audit. This is a concrete, falsifiable, narrow hypothesis for a future fix — not proposed or applied here, since V1 and the underlying parser both remain frozen this phase.
hard_negative_75pct_blind_spot_deep_dive.model_number_cross_check: independently: the trusted candidate's raw title states model codes 'FSACQD-XF18HIB/FSACQD-XC18HIB', while the Amazon listing states 'FSACME-XF18CIB' — a different model-code family (FSACQD vs FSACME) entirely, corroborating DIFFERENT_PRODUCT from a second, independent angle beyond the missed cooling_mode conflict.

verdict.reasoning: Unchanged from Phase 2's PROMISING, now on a materially stronger evidentiary footing. The reference audit found the contamination pattern is WORSE than ADR-320 first reported (3 confirmed instances, not 2, with the true population-wide extent still unknown) — but also found the contamination is STRUCTURALLY CONFINED: it never touches the RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier (0/20 valid-tier canonicals show it, and neither of the 2 canonicals that WERE HIGH_CONFIDENCE winners are affected), and cleaning the reference universe for the REVIEW tier only ever made V1's output MORE conservative, never less (one case downgraded to NO_CANDIDATE, none upgraded). A second, independent and previously-unrecognized finding — 2 of the 4 RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE cases were already correctly linked in production before this lab ran — turns out to be a strong out-of-band precision check (V1 agreed with an independent, pre-existing ground truth in 2/2 such cases) while correcting the 'rescue yield' framing down to 2 genuinely novel rescues (TCL, Haier) among the exhaustively-verified tier.
verdict.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_RESULTS_ON_CLEAN_REFEREN: 4/4 unchanged and unaffected by the reference audit (2 genuinely novel: TCL, Haier; 2 independently pre-confirmed: LG FreshDV, LG ArtCool)

verdict.NEXT_SAFEST_STEP: Before any production discussion: (a) formally classify the TCL and Haier trusted canonicals (behind the 2 genuinely-novel rescues) under this same CLEAN/SUSPECT/CONTAMINATED taxonomy, since condition 1 of the pilot gate is currently unmet for them; (b) run a full, not-yet-attempted scan of the ~970 low-confidence-tier AC canonicals for the AI-Pro/Cosmo merge signature now proven to recur (3 real instances found incidentally), to learn its true extent rather than assume it stops at 3; (c) define a rollback plan for whatever pilot shape is eventually proposed. None of this requires touching Products 2 or tuning V1 — it is further read-only diagnosis, the same posture as this phase.
